failures.pattern: [38;2;74;222;128m[1m✓[0m reveal shows 1/3 pass count on failure
failures.root_cause: sw-e2e-integration-test and sw-intent-analysis-test exited 1, likely due to missing/invalid API credentials or environment setup rather than a code regression
failures.fix: Check test logs for these two suites for auth/env errors and gate them on required secrets or fix the underlying assertion

failures.root_cause: Pipeline stage tests expect artifacts (plan.md, review.md) and non-zero exit paths that the mocked build/plan/review stages never write, and one intelligence test's jq call receives non-numeric complexity output
failures.fix: Fix mock stage scripts to write plan.md/review.md artifacts before stage completion and sanitize the complexity value passed to jq in the low-complexity intelligence test

failures.pattern: [2m  loop behavior: iterations on test failure[0m
failures.root_cause: Multiple pipeline/loop stages (plan, review, resume, full E2E) fail to write expected artifacts (plan.md, review.md) because the build/test loop's self-healing retry logic doesn't consistently regenerate artifacts on iteration, and a jq parse error on non-numeric complexity output breaks the low-complexity skip check
failures.fix: Fix jq numeric parsing in the complexity intelligence check (quote/validate the value before passing to jq) and ensure pipeline_write_plan/pipeline_write_review are called unconditionally before stage completion so retries don't skip artifact generation

failures.root_cause: sw-pipeline-vitals-test failures show duration_anomaly status returning 'unavailable' instead of 'anomaly'/'normal', and the anomaly event isn't emitted — the baseline-anomaly detection isn't picking up the running stage/baseline data during the test
failures.fix: Check lib/baseline-anomaly.sh stage lookup against the test's mocked events.jsonl/baseline fixture paths — likely a path or event-schema mismatch causing the detector to see no matching stage as running

failures.root_cause: One of the 128 tests in the suite failed but the failing assertion was not included in the provided log excerpt (only passing suites shown)
failures.fix: Re-run the failing test file with verbose output to capture the specific FAIL line and stack trace, then inspect the associated assertion

failures.root_cause: sw-pipeline-test.sh plan/design/resume/cleanup tests fail because plan.md is never written to .claude/pipeline-artifacts (plan stage output path or mock changed), causing cascading failures in dependent E2E/resume/cleanup tests
failures.fix: Verify pipeline_stage_plan writes plan.md to the expected artifacts path and that the mock claude CLI produces it during tests; fix path/mock mismatch
